title: Restocking Fee Limits for PAP Supply Replenishment Program Members — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Restocking Fee Limits for PAP Supply Replenishment Program Members — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Member terms.** Supply-program patients have the restocking fee on the refund of a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit capped:

- a patient whose **PAP Supply Replenishment Program** enrollment is active and has been open **12 months or more** pays at most **140.00 USD**;
- a patient whose enrollment is active and has been open **less than 12 months** pays at most **170.00 USD**;
- any other patient pays the fee uncapped.

The cap acts on the restocking fee as charged, after its rounding: the fee deducted is the lower of that fee and the cap.

**Where the facts are read.** From the patient's PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment in status active: its status and its enrollment date. The months open are the whole calendar months from the enrollment date to today, a month being complete when today's day of the month reaches the enrollment date's day.

## Combinations

| Enrollment active | Months open | Restocking fee deducted |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | the lower of the fee and 140.00 |
| yes | less than 12 | the lower of the fee and 170.00 |
| no active enrollment | — | the fee, uncapped |

## Cases (hypothetical dates and fees)

- Enrollment opened 15 March of one year; today is 14 March of the next: 11 months open, cap 170.00. A fee of 277.50 is deducted as 170.00.
- Same enrollment, today 15 March of the next year: 12 months open, cap 140.00; the fee of 277.50 is deducted as 140.00.
- Active enrollment of 3 months, fee 112.35: below the 170.00 cap, deducted as 112.35.
- Enrollment cancelled: the fee is deducted uncapped.
